answers.core: Scene instancing is a core feature of godot that should (in my personal opinion) provide a way of loading & instancing scenes seamlessly.
answers.workaround:
It would require more than just a few lines. One could use `PackedScene._bundled` to create the nodes one by one.
I am not sure if this should be done as `_bundled` seems more like an implementation detail that should not be relied on.

title: `PackedScene.instance()` should not cause lag or a different way to instance interactively should be provided
